The Budget Explorer's Guide to Des Moines: 25 Free & Low-Cost Fall Activities

Discover the best of Des Moines without breaking the bank! From scenic trails bursting with autumn colors to free museum days and family-friendly festivals, Iowa's capital city offers countless budget-friendly ways to experience fall's finest moments.

Outdoor Adventures (100% Free)

Parks & Trails

  • Explore the iconic Pappajohn Sculpture Park in Downtown Des Moines - featuring 31 world-class sculptures amid fall foliage
  • Walk, bike, or run the 63-mile Neal Smith Trail connecting Big Creek State Park to the East Village
  • Photograph fall colors at Gray's Lake Park, especially stunning during October
  • Visit the Greater Des Moines Botanical Garden's outdoor gardens (free areas only)

Nature & Wildlife

  • Bird watching at Saylorville Lake during fall migration
  • Explore Walnut Woods State Park's walking trails
  • Visit Browns Woods Forest Preserve in West Des Moines

Cultural Experiences (Free or Under $10)

Museums & Art

  • Des Moines Art Center (always free admission)
  • State Historical Museum of Iowa (free)
  • Science Center of Iowa (half-price admission on First Fridays)
  • World Food Prize Hall of Laureates tours (free on Tuesdays)

Local Events & Festivals

  • Downtown Farmers' Market (free entry, through October)
  • Valley Junction Farmers' Market (free)
  • Des Moines Fall Art Festival
  • Beaverdale Fall Festival
